idle.note: Gemini idle v2 (10 s), camera push-in removed (tools/build_clips.py); played as a random walk: forward/back between calm frames + low-difference jumps, so it never repeats as a 10 s loop

talk.note: Gemini talk clip 3 (seamless 9 s loop) in the same framing; shown only while his voice sounds, mouth re-chosen from the voice level (anim.json)

talk2.note: owner's clip 2026-11-09 (talking with paw gestures), same framing; first/last frame nearly match, so it loops; a line picks talk or talk2

win.note: Gemini coin-shower win, same framing; plays to the calm frame before the hat tip (8.3 s); the rarer variety win

win2.note: owner's clip 2026-11-09: paws up, hat adjust, settles back (camera push-in removed); the main win (7 s)

loss.note: built from idle frames: eyes-closed 'oh well', slowed, small head tilt + sigh (~2.6 s); gives way when his line starts

alive.note: breathing <=0.9% on his body column, warm lamp swell, a few dust motes
